 News › News News › Karwa Chauth school holiday on October 29th, 2026: Schools closed in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh Karwa Chauth school holiday on October 29th, 2026: Schools closed in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh
 Ashita Kashyap Updated: Oct 28, 2026, 09:55 IST Karwa Chauth school holiday on 29th October 2026 School Holiday on October 29, 2026: Karwa Chauth will be celebrated on Thursday, October 29th. Reports indicate that female teachers in Uttar Pradesh’s basic education schools have been granted leave.
 However, this does not automatically mean that schools will remain closed for students. In Punjab, the holiday status should be checked against the applicable school calendar and official notice. Read more to know what students and parents need to know.
 School Holiday on October 29: What should students in Punjab and UP Know?
 Students and parents in Punjab and Uttar Pradesh are wondering if schools will stay closed on Thursday, October 29 on account of Karwa Chauth. This festival is celebrated widely in India but a festival falls on a weekday does not mean all schools will automatically close.
 According to a report by a renowned media house on October 27, the Basic Education Department in Aligarh, Uttar Pradesh has given leave to female teachers working in its schools for Karwa Chauth. However, this decision does not mean all students in the district or the entire state will get a holiday. It is a leave for specific staff.
 The situation in Punjab also needs attention. The state’s 2026 holiday list includes Karaka Chaturthi, also known as Karwa Chauth, which is marked as a restricted holiday. 
 A restricted holiday is not the same as a public holiday, it means schools are not required to shut down.
 Therefore, students should look at the notice, from their school or the local education office. That way they can be sure whether classes will be held on October 29 or not. It is best to check rather than assume.
 Uttar Pradesh school holiday on October 29: Will students get a day off?
 In Uttar Pradesh, the latest reports point to a holiday provision for female teachers in basic education schools on Karwa Chauth.
 The difference between a teacher’s leave and a school holiday is important. If eligible teachers receive leave, it does not necessarily mean that the school will be closed for students. The actual arrangement may depend on the applicable education department instructions and the school’s official communication.
 It is advised to parents to kindly check messages from their child’s school, including notices shared through official school groups or other communication channels. 
 Students in private schools, aided institutions and schools following different academic calendars should not assume that the same rule applies to them.
 Punjab school holiday on October 29: Is Karwa Chauth a public holiday? 
 Punjab celebrates Karwa Chauth, but students should not assume that schools across the state will remain closed on October 29.
 The Punjab government’s 2026 holiday calendar includes Karaka Chaturthi (Karwa Chauth) in its list of restricted holidays. Such holidays may be available to eligible employees under the applicable rules, but they are not the same as compulsory closures for all institutions.
 School holiday arrangements may also differ according to the institution’s calendar and directions issued by the relevant authorities. Students should check with their school for confirmation of whether classes, examinations or other academic activities will take place on Thursday.
 Why is Karwa Chauth celebrated? 
 Karwa Chauth is a long‑standing Hindu festival that is mainly celebrated in western parts of India. Karwa Chauth is celebrated on the day after the full moon in the Hindu lunar month of Kartik.
 Traditionally married Hindu women keep a fast the whole day and pray for the health, happiness and long life of their husbands. This day often starts with Sargi, a meal before dawn around 4 am in the morning, then prayers and other rituals. In the evening women perform the worship and break their fast once they see the Moon.
 Karwa Chauth is celebrated with enthusiasm in states, such as Uttar Pradesh, Punjab, Haryana and Rajasthan. 
 Still the cultural importance of Karwa Chauth does not automatically turn it into a compulsory school holiday across the country.
 How to check the school holiday status for October 29?
 Before making plans, students and parents should the following:
 Check the latest circular issued by their school.
 Look for an official announcement from the district education authorities.
 Check whether examinations or other scheduled school activities will continue.
 Karwa Chauth falls on Thursday, October 29, 2026. Reports indicate leave for female teachers in certain Uttar Pradesh basic education schools, while Punjab lists the festival as a restricted holiday. A blanket school closure across both states has not been established by the information reviewed. Students should follow their school’s official instructions for the final decision.
